recommendation: Do not spend a separate confirm on the decoy. If the coordinator re-confirms KP (as the wave-9 lessons suggest), KdA can replace K_A at no measured cost (paired -0.0011 n.s., 44/50 cohorts identical) and adds +0.14 per battle against single-copy initializer-signature counters. That makes it a low-priority promote-candidate add-on, not a field gain. Caveats: (1) 2 counter copies or a decoy-aware counter still wipe it. (2) KdA uses 254 of A's 256 bytes, so it blocks A-side combinations that need the dead-tail space (KL/locpatA A = 214 B); KT's 1-byte A edit still fits. Pick the A-side field edit first and add the decoy only if space remains. If no confirm slot is used for it, keep KP as is.
